claim_boundary: The archived confusion counts reproduce per-category precision, recall and F1 and the aggregate macro and micro F1.
Every detector was scored against every span, so a detection without a matching gold label counts as a false positive.
TRAIL annotations may not be exhaustive, so measured precision is a lower bound.
Categories are 11 Pisama detector buckets mapped from the 14 TRAIL categories, not the TRAIL categories themselves.
The run is in-distribution because 144 of 148 traces appeared in calibration material.
The run evaluated the Pisama platform detectors on 2026-07-29, not this package release.
The archive does not contain the prediction-level data needed to reproduce joint accuracy.
